args.thought: I need to find all superpowers of male superheroes. I'll join superhero, hero_power, and superpower tables. Male has gender_id = 1 based on the column_values output. I'll select power_name from superpower table.
args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name 
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.gender_id = 1
ORDER BY sp.power_name
